scope: Proposition 5.3 (Persistence near an entry) of the manuscript “Sharp nodal length on smooth surfaces” (preprints/Sharp-nodal-length-on-smooth-surfaces-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 350 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 1301138f44ca53ef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are a finite threshold H, a number δ > 0, and an integer J ≥ 0 such that every entry Q admits a measurable set YQ ⊂ D∗Q, where D∗ = 20A, with |YQ| ≥ δ|Q|, #{F ∈ E : s(F) < s(Q), y ∈ F} ≤ J for almost every y ∈ YQ. (5.2) Only entries of the given tree are counted, including when YQ extends outside the root.
